source: The owner's words typed in the same working session as reviews/OWNER_BOOK_WHOLE_SCREEN_2026-11-25.json, in the desktop app, after the session showed him the whole-screen book (pull request 106). This record is written by the same session: it saw the words below typed.
theWords: а можно еще ближе к концепту? стандартные формы можно заменить сгенерированными значками где только можно?
whatHeAsksFor: The screens closer still to the concept he chose on 2026-11-24 (direction А, a real book: ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/book-polish-2026-11-24/out/dm-a-real-book.png).
Standard form controls replaced with generated icons wherever that is possible.
whatTheSessionFound: At the width of his own window (about 766 px) the Scene was not a spread of the book at all: the two pages began at 1024 px, and below that the Scene was the place's picture under dark glass plates. The concept's page — running heads, the title in the page's middle over an ornament, round portraits, the ribbon down the gutter, the page's number at its foot — was not set at any width.

authorized: The Scene's spread set as the concept sets it, from 701 px: running heads, the title over the book's ornament, the plate in a frame, who is here as round portraits, the ribbon down the gutter, the page's number between drawn hands, the dice at the right page's foot.
The same print for the story's page in the Book.

Vignettes drawn by Codex CLI (one set for every book) for the options of forms and for actions; tiles in place of bare radio buttons and of short lists; the heroes' portraits in place of lists of their names; a drawn tick, ring and list mark where a form keeps them.
The journeys moved to the tiles; a pull request stacked on the whole-screen book.
notAuthorized: Opening the two built-in adventures' written books (they wait for his reading, ADR 0074 §2.8).

standingOwnerRulesThisWorkKeeps: 2026-11-20: no rails — «DnD — это про свободу выбора и действий».
2026-11-21: sections full screen with a way to close, everything at hand, the least scrolling; every main DM task has a visible entry named with his own word.
2026-11-21: «Читать всё самому» — every phrase a model wrote is read by the owner before it reaches a table.
2026-11-23: each book has its own style from its campaign's art; book materials by Codex CLI.
2026-11-25: the book is the whole screen; everything is in the book or in a bookmark; show a real screen early.
unchangedBoundaries: The World Engine alone changes the world; rules and legality stay the server's.
Knowledge isolation: a player's client and the table's screen receive only their own projections.
No AI at the table; no paid provider call beyond the pictures Codex CLI makes for the book materials.
Nothing is merged or deployed by the session without the owner's word.
